'''Hazeen''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who served the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent Sith Empire.

==Biography==
During the Empire's [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Hazeen infiltrated the Corellian rebel forces that were planning on leading an assault on the occupation forces. Hazeen managed to alert the Imperial forces through the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[G-05]], who was situated by [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]], and sent a strike team to put a stop to the attack.
